articles.title: Modal Motors is trying to cut China out of electric motors entirely | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The startup is working on small, light motors with no rare-earth magnets that are suited for drones, fans, and robots.
articles.body_text: Lately, it seems like everyone is talking about bringing manufacturing back to the United States, especially when it comes to hard tech like drones and robotics. Michael Van Steenburg thinks he’s ahead of the game. Van Steenburg spent the last decade building all kinds of electric motors in the U.S. and North America, and now he wants to do it again with his new startup, Modal Motors . This time, he wants to ditch rare-earth magnets entirely, in a bid to further separate the U.S. from China’s supply chain. As one of the founders in Startup Battlefield 200 who will compete at TechCrunch Disrupt next month, he thinks it’s an urgent pitch to make. “China’s already flexed its muscles a couple times,” Van Steenburg said, referring to the country restricting access to rare-earth products . There are other companies working on setting up electric motor manufacturing and supply chains in the U.S., but Van Steenburg argues they’re doing it the wrong way by continuing to rely on rare-earth magnets. Domestic supply of those materials is still years away, he said. “Other people are ‘reshoring,’ [but] they’re basically knocking off Chinese motors and just doing it in the U.S. But they’re hoping that the U.S. rare-earth magnet system is going to get up to speed fast enough,” he said. “It’s going to still be a while longer before they can actually replace China.” Modal Motors has two products that it’s developing ahead of Disrupt. One is a small electric motor meant for drones that can also work in fans, blowers, and even actuators. It’s designed to “minimize mass while delivering maximum torque density and efficiency,” according to the startup’s website. The more radical design is what Modal refers to as the “Hybrid Enigma Drive,” a planar — or flat — electric motor that can fit in lower-profile spaces. Van Steenburg is drawing on decades of experience in the automotive industry to develop these motors and get them customer-ready. But there’s also an irony in the work Van Steenburg is doing to make Modal Motors’ products a China-free option; in the late 1990s, he worked on a hybrid gas-electric drivetrain that China wanted to put in its so-called “People’s Car.” “It’s kind of comical,” he said, thinking back on that experience and how much the world has changed. What hasn’t changed, he said, is his outsider streak and strong conviction about doing things that are hard. “I always tell people that the clock started ticking 25 years ago, and in that whole time, I’ve watched a slow-motion train wreck as China’s been going around the world, grabbing mines, grabbing mineral rights, doing all these things, and slowly but surely monopolizing the entire rare-earth supply chain,” he said. articles.title: Disney+ and Hulu add to the growing trend of streaming inflation | TechCrunch
articles.summary: At the same time, Disney appears to be exploring new ways to expand its streaming business beyond simply raising subscription prices.
articles.body_text: Streaming is getting more expensive again. Disney is the latest media giant to raise prices for its streaming services, adding to a growing pattern across the industry. The increases come roughly a year after Disney’s last major streaming price hike . Disney is raising the price of its ad-free Disney+ and Hulu bundle to $21.99 a month, up from $19.99, whereas the ad-free stand-alone plans are each rising to $21.49 per month, up from $18.99. The company is also increasing the price of its stand-alone ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu plans to $12.49 a month. The new prices are reflected on Disney+’s support page . Bloomberg was the first to report the changes. Disney+ and Hulu are hardly alone. Streaming companies have spent the past several years steadily increasing prices. Peacock and Apple TV also raised prices in August, while Netflix increased prices earlier this year. When Disney+ launched in 2019, its basic monthly subscription cost $6.99. Since then, the service has gradually moved further away from that intro price as Disney has tried to turn streaming into a profitable part of its entertainment business. At the same time, Disney appears to be exploring new ways to expand its streaming business beyond simply raising subscription prices. The company has reportedly explored the possibility of introducing a free tier for Disney+. This could put the company in more direct competition with platforms such as YouTube and Tubi, which have been capturing a growing share of consumers’ viewing time. Earlier this month, Disney+ also introduced “ Playlists ,” a new feature designed to help users discover and continuously watch curated selections of content. The company is making changes on the technology side as well. Disney recently hired Karandeep Anand as its first-ever chief technology officer. Anand is the former CEO of Character.AI, a company Disney previously accused of infringing on its intellectual property. articles.title: Elgato won over creators — its new Neo line is for everyone else
articles.summary: Elgato is launching a Neo line of products that aren’t all about gaming or streaming. A new webcam, microphone, and Stream Deck are targeted at everyone.
articles.body_text: If you watch a Twitch streamer, it’s almost guaranteed that they will be using at least one Elgato product. After dominating this part of the market for years, Elgato is now shifting its primary focus away from gaming with its new Neo line while also preparing a bevy of AI features to improve new and existing gear. Neo is a collection of Elgato’s most popular products made simpler, more affordable, and more compact so they can be used easily with a laptop or iPad. “They look more accessible, they look more friendly,” says Julian Fest, general manager of Elgato, in an interview with The Verge. “The entire industrial design is focused on being more appealing to a less technical audience.” The $99.99 Stream Deck Neo is the star of the show, essentially the command center for Elgato’s products. It has eight LCD keys that can be paired to automate tasks like turning on lights or joining video calls. I use Stream Deck buttons to mute myself on calls, pause my notifications in Slack, and see what music is playing on Spotify. Elgato has added two capacitive buttons to let you switch pages for an infinite amount of customizable keys. There’s also an info display between these buttons that acts like a digital clock that’s always available. [Image: The Stream Deck Neo is small enough for laptop use. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25404243/Stream_Deck_Neo_Lifestyle_Shot_03.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Neo is Elgato’s way of bringing its expertise in streaming to the masses — an acknowledgment that the line between creator and professional is increasingly blurred as more and more people dial into meetings remotely. But it’s also an admission that setting up webcams, lights, and microphones isn’t an easy task for most people. “We want the out-of-box experience to be quite seamless,” says Fest. Elgato’s Neo line is designed to be plug-and-play so you can quickly and easily improve your setup without having to install multiple apps and tweak settings. Elgato is trying to appeal to people who are looking for something in between a basic webcam / microphone combination and the more high-end audio and video setup it’s typically known for. [Image: The Wave Neo microphone and Game Capture Neo. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25404238/twarren_elgato2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] The lineup includes key hardware for video calls. The $99.99 Facecam Neo webcam supports 1080p video at 60fps, includes an integrated privacy shutter, and can easily slot onto the top of a monitor or your laptop. The $89.99 Wave Neo condenser microphone has a raised desktop stand and a tap-to-mute feature and will also integrate into Elgato’s more advanced Wave Link app. If you need better lighting at your desk or on the go, the $89.99 Key Light Neo is a diffused light that’s designed to pair with a webcam. While Elgato’s other Key Lights have typically shipped with stands, the Key Light Neo can be mounted to the top of a laptop or a monitor so it doesn’t take up any desk space. It has up to 800 lumens of brightness, and there are controls at the front to adjust the brightness and color temperature. The $119.99 Game Capture Neo is still very much rooted in the history of Elgato products aimed at streamers and gamers. You can use it to capture video from a PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch, and it also includes pass-through support of up to 4K / 60fps with HDR enabled. Game Capture Neo supports capture at up to 1080p 60fps, so it’s ideal for Twitch or YouTube streaming. It’s designed to work out of the box with Discord, OBS Studio, and other apps for streaming to Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok. All of these Neo devices are available to order today, with the exception of the Facecam Neo webcam. Elgato says it’s making “further fine tuning” to the out of box experience, and expects to launch Facecam Neo in May or June. [Image: The Neo products have packaging that you can easily recycle instead of plastic. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25404237/twarren_elgatoneo1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] “It’s the start of a longer-term mission where we’re really trying to make more people aware that even if you don’t consider yourself a content creator, in many ways you are,” says Fest. Elgato is targeting people participating in online sales, video podcasts, events, product demonstrations, community building, and other areas where audio and visual content has been growing in recent years. “Neo really is a bet that this trend is going to keep accelerating,” says Fest. With just one exception, each product in the Neo lineup costs less than $100. That’s still a lot more than a $20 microphone or webcam you could buy on Amazon, but the Neo devices are designed to be premium only at a lower price point. “We have a history of launching products where everybody is like, ‘That’s way overpriced, and I can get this cheaper elsewhere,’” says Fest. “You’re always going to find cheaper options, but I do think we’ve built products here that, for a lot of people, are going to hit that sweet spot.” [Image: The Key Light Neo is very compact and you can wrap the USB cord around the rear. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25404240/twarren_elgato3.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] The entire Neo range comes in a white finish, which is designed to blend into rooms with white walls. The compact nature of the Neo lineup also makes it easy to use these devices in smaller spaces or even on the go. All of these Neo products also work on iPad for the first time, a clear invitation to an emerging line of creators that make TikTok and Instagram videos with just their phones or tablets. “We’re able to really accessorize an iPad now and make it a content creation powerhouse,” says Fest. The iPad is often marketed as a creative device, but “the reality of the situation is that the majority of people just use their iPads to watch Netflix and YouTube,” says Fest. Even the Stream Deck Neo will work on an iPad, thanks to a new SDK that will allow app developers to send a profile to the device that lets it control their app. That works around the many restrictions in iOS that don’t exist on Windows or macOS, but it means it will take some time for app developers to build up this support. [Image: The Game Capture Neo can be used on an iPad to capture gameplay. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25404242/Game_Capture_Neo_Lifestyle_Shot_01.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] As Elgato looks at new workflows and increased momentum away from being seen as just for gamers, it’s also looking at using AI to make its products even smarter. Fest tells me that Elgato has a new Light Strip launching next month where the 160 LEDs are individually addressable. This is Elgato’s first AI push, with a feature designed to improve how you create a colorful scene. “We built a frontend where you can put in ‘I want a dark forest,’ and on the backend, it will go to ChatGPT ... which will always give us a range of RGB values that serves you three options as a user to pick from,” says Fest. Elgato’s new Prompter hardware is also getting some AI-powered improvements. The teleprompter will soon have voice-based auto-scrolling, making it easy to read off of a script and not have to fiddle with buttons to pause the scrolling. “A few years ago, this would have been a pain in the ass to build,” says Fest, but the availability of large language models has made this a lot easier for the 140-person team working on these products. But for all the advantages of AI, the use cases could eradicate the need for Elgato’s webcams and microphones if the future swings radically toward AI agents that handle our meetings for us. “To some people, that might be appealing, but I don’t think that’s the future I want to fight for,” says Fest. “I think AI can help us in everything we do, and it can make things easier and maybe more fun. It can help unlock creativity, and that’s where we’ll invest and try to build.”

articles.title: Coachella will continue streaming on YouTube through 2026
articles.summary: YouTube and Coachella organizers Goldenvoice renewed their exclusive partnership through 2026. That means fans all over the world will be able to stream the annual festival for free for another few more years.
articles.body_text: Can’t fly to California for Coachella? No problem. You’ll still be able to stream the annual arts and music festival live from the comfort of your own home for at least another few years. YouTube and Coachella organizers Goldenvoice announced on YouTube’s official blog that they’ve renewed their exclusive partnership through 2026. As a result, fans around the world will continue to stream the festival live for free from YouTube as well as watch on-demand videos of performances. “Our partnership with YouTube brings Coachella to everyone around the world,” said Goldenvoice president Paul Tollett. “The 2023 lineup sees performers from Brazil, France, Iceland, India, Jamaica, Nigeria, Puerto Rico, South Korea, Spain, and beyond, and bringing international fans closer to their hometown artists is important to our team.” For this year’s event, viewers will also be able to watch behind-the-scenes content on YouTube Shorts and talk to other fans through Live Chat. There will also be livestream and playlist integrations between YouTube and YouTube Music and on-site activations with YouTube creators and artists. Fans can buy Coachella and artist merchandise through YouTube Shopping, while YouTube Premium subscribers will be able to access exclusive content. This is the 11th year Coachella’s been available to stream live on YouTube. YouTube first became the exclusive livestreaming home of Coachella after signing an agreement with Goldenvoice in 2011, reports Billboard. They last renewed their partnership in 2018 for three years, though the festival was postponed in 2020 and 2021 due to the pandemic. Coachella will take place this year during the following two weekends: April 14th through 16th and April 21st through 23rd. Performers include the likes of Bad Bunny, Frank Ocean, Blackpink, Björk, Gorillaz, The Chemical Brothers, Blondie, Charli XCX, and more.

articles.title: The investigation into Tesla Autopilot’s emergency vehicle problem is getting bigger
articles.summary: The investigation into Tesla Autopilot is now affecting the automaker’s rivals. NHTSA sent requests to 12 major car companies, including Ford, GM, VW, and Toyota, requesting information into their Level 2 driver assist systems.
articles.body_text: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is requesting advanced driver assist data from 12 automakers as it seeks to expand its investigation into Tesla’s Autopilot. The government is probing a dozen incidents involving Teslas crashing into emergency vehicles. According to Automotive News, the agency’s Office of Defects Investigation sent letters to a dozen major automakers, including Ford, General Motors, Toyota, and Volkswagen, requesting information regarding their Level 2 driver assist systems, in which the vehicle can simultaneously control steering, braking, and acceleration under specific circumstances. Automakers are being asked to provide the number of vehicles with Level 2 systems that have been manufactured in the US, as well as the total number of miles covered with those systems engaged and a recent list of any changes or updates. NHTSA is also requesting customer complaints, field and crash reports, and any lawsuits related to the Level 2 systems. The data request comes less than two weeks after NHTSA sent an order to Tesla to provide data on the operation of its Autopilot system, including details on which of its sold vehicles are equipped with Autopilot as well as the system’s operating parameters. The agency’s investigation into Tesla could have wide-ranging implications for Tesla, which has pushed the boundaries in releasing experimental software to untrained customers in order to advance its vision of autonomous driving. NHTSA’s investigation covers an estimated 765,000 Tesla vehicles that were released from 2014 through 2021. The agency is looking into 12 crashes in which Tesla owners using the company’s Autopilot features have crashed into stationary emergency vehicles, resulting in 17 injuries and one fatality. Most of these incidents took place after dark, with the software ignoring scene control measures including warning lights, flares, cones, and an illuminated arrow board. Tesla has until October 22nd to hand over the data. US-based automakers like Ford, GM, and Stellantis have until November 3rd, and all other car companies, like Toyota, Subaru, Nissan, and Honda, have until November 17th. Automakers that fail to respond could face civil penalties of up to $115 million. A spokesperson for Toyota said the company would comply with NHTSA’s request. A VW spokesperson declined comment, while media contacts for the other automakers did not respond to requests for comment.

articles.title: Ovanliga draget – när Trump tog emot Xi Jinping
articles.summary: Här landar Xi Jinping i USA. På flygbasen Joint Base Andrews möttes han och hustrun Peng Liyuan av det amerikanska presidentparet. Det är ett mottagande Donald Trump inte brukar bjuda sina gäster på.
articles.body_text: På flygbasen Joint Base Andrews möttes han och hustrun Peng Liyuan av det amerikanska presidentparet. Det är ett mottagande Donald Trump inte brukar bjuda sina gäster på. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Sent på torsdagskvällen landade det kinesiska planet med president Xi Jinping och hans hustru Peng Liyuan på Joint Base Andrews i Washington. Samtidigt rådde febril aktivitet in i det sista på flygbasen. De amerikanska soldaterna rullade ut röda mattan och kröp på knä för att få allt perfekt inför det Xis första besök i USA på tre år – och det första officiella statsbesöket på tio år. Vid midnatt, svensk tid, klev de av. Nedanför möttes de av sina amerikanska motsvarigheter, Donald och Melania Trump. Att amerikanska presidenter tar emot besökare redan på flygplatsen är ovanligt, med undantag från påvliga besök. Men Trump gav Putin samma ära när han landade i Alaska i augusti förra året, då USA:s president även applåderade sin gäst. Annars är det sedan många årtionden kutym att presidenten möter sina gäster först i Vita huset. När Trump besökte Kina i maj lät Xi sin vicepresident möta den amerikanska presidenten när han landade. Ungefär samtidigt som Xi landade avslöjade USA:s finansminister Scott Bessent att USA och Kina förlängt ”vapenvilan” i sitt handelskrig med två månader. Den ettåriga pausen, en överenskommelse som ingicks i Sydkorea för snart ett år sedan, innebar bland annat att vissa tullar och restriktioner för sällsynta metaller slopades. Ny deadline för ett handelsavtal är enligt Bessent nu satt till 10 januari. XI Jinpings besök fortsätter på torsdagsmorgonen med en stor välkomstceremoni i Vita huset där 479 soldater från militärens alla grenar ska delta, med hedersvakt och fanfar. – Det är anmärkningsvärt att Trump går så långt för att visa den här sortens respekt för USA:s främsta geopolitiska rival, säger Jonathan Czin, som var Kinachef i säkerhetsrådet under Biden och nu arbetar vid tankesmedjan Brookings, till Bloomberg . – Det är oklart vad, om något, som Trump får i utbyte för sina många uppvisningar av respekt. På torsdagskvällen hålls en statsmiddag i Vita huset, där en lång rad techledare deltar. Donald Trump har inför mötet låtit världen få veta att de båda ledarna ska diskutera ”allt” i sina samtal, där handelskriget, Iran, Taiwan och AI väntas stå i fokus. Detta är en nyhetsartikel. Det har rört upp starka känslor hos föräldrar – och i skrivande stund har nära 300 skrivit under en namninsamling mot beslutet. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Frågorna är många men svaren få. Ungefär så summerar Frida Wadenby situationen. Hon har två, snart tre barn som går i Olovslundsskolan och hon vaknade likt många andra föräldrar upp förra onsdagen till beskedet: i två års tid ska eleverna i årskurs ett till fem bussas fram och tillbaka från Bromma till Vällingby, en sträcka på omkring sex kilometer. – Jag har all respekt för att man kommer fram till att det ska renoveras och självklart vill man att sina barn ska ha en sån bra skolmiljö som möjligt, säger hon. Problemet för Frida Wadenby är att eleverna ska bussas fram och tillbaka i två år. – Hade man lagt fram på bordet så här: ”ja, men vi har gjort den här utredningen. Vi har tittat på de här platserna. Det funkar inte för att... Vi har tittat på de här platserna, det fungerar inte heller för att...” Men nu har man bara presenterat: ”de ska bussas”. Föräldrar som Expressen varit i kontakt med menar att kommunikationen lämnat en hel del att önska. I informationsbladet som skickades ut framgår det att det är en ekonomisk fråga primärt. Det är helt enkelt för dyrt att exempelvis ställa upp baracker på skolgården och bedriva en del av undervisningen där. Frida Wadenby har tillsammans med ett stort antal andra föräldrar försökt få svar på frågan om vad beslutsunderlaget är, men hittills har de inte lyckats. – Känslan är locket på, det är under all kritik. Nära 300 personer har i skrivande stund skrivit under en namninsamling mot beslutet, och samtidigt har ett hundratal föräldrar gått samman i en stor chattgrupp där de bland annat diskuterar vägar framåt.

Han har varit medlem i partiet i ett drygt år och är tidigare okänd i politiska sammanhang, men driver bolaget Afritech Growth AB tillsammans med Agneta Nyvall, tidigare moderat oppositionsråd i Borlänge . Nu pausas dock bolaget, på grund av Alis riksdagsplats, skriver Dagens industri. – Riksdagsplatsen är ju en otroligt viktig och fin plats. Så den kommer han att värna. Vi har ett långsiktigt mål. Fyra år är ingenting, säger Agneta Nyvall till tidningen. Till Dagens industri säger hon nu att det var Mohamed Alis idé, och att han sökte upp henne med den för två år sen. – Det är ett intressant projekt. I ett land som Somalia är det otroligt mycket som måste åtgärdas för att människor ska känna sig trygga och för att man ska kunna bygga företag, säger Nyvall till Di, och fortsätter: – Sedan om det blir någonting, det vet vi inte än. Jag har ingen aning. Det är väl så när man startar företag.

articles.title: Trumps tunga vecka – bakslag efter bakslag
articles.summary: Donald Trump vill ha mer uppskattning – och fler som försvarar honom. Efter en vecka fylld av motgångar växer presidentens frustration bakom kulisserna, enligt Wall Street Journal.
articles.body_text: Donald Trump vill ha mer uppskattning – och fler som försvarar honom. Efter en vecka fylld av motgångar växer presidentens frustration bakom kulisserna, enligt Wall Street Journal . Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Donald Trump uppges vara frustrerad efter flera politiska och juridiska motgångar den senaste veckan, enligt Wall Street Journal. Bland bakslagen finns domstolsbeslut om Kennedy Center och poströstning samt en räntehöjning från Federal Reserve. Trump ska också vara missnöjd med att för få allierade försvarar honom offentligt. Vita huset försöker nu hitta politiska och utrikespolitiska framgångar som Trump kan lyfta fram inför valet. Ett tack vore på sin plats, tycker Donald Trump . Vid ett möte i Ovala rummet ska presidenten nyligen ha uttryckt stor frustration över att framstående personer i Washington inte offentligt tackat honom för arbetet med att göra om Kennedy Center, skriver Wall Street Journal. Trump vill sätta upp sitt namn på kulturinstitutionens fasad, döpa om det till Trump-Kennedy Center och genomföra stora renoveringar. Men planerna har mött motstånd. Förra veckan slog en federal domare fast att ”minnesmärken över president Trump – eller någon eller något annat – inte kan sättas upp vid Kennedy Center utan kongressens godkännande”. Bakslaget är långt ifrån det enda som har väckt presidentens irritation i veckan som gick, enligt rådgivare, tjänstemän och andra personer nära presidenten som WSJ har talat med.

articles.title: Valfuskhärvan: Riktade in sig på tre grupper – erbjöd mat och en hundring | Expressen
articles.summary: Den 13 september går Sverige till val. Följ Expressens direktrapport med senaste nytt inför valet.
articles.body_text: Enligt uppgifter till DN har tre grupper med somalisk bakgrund särskilt sökts upp: Kvinnor i utanförskap, missbrukare och unga män som inte hade tänkt rösta. – Ibland har de gett en hundralapp eller två till den som röstat, och bjudit på något att äta, säger en källa till tidningen. Under onsdagen upptäckte valnämnden i Simrishamn att de glömt räkna 121 giltiga förtidsröster. Missen tros endast ha påverkat lokalvalen. Nu kan kommunvalet behöva tas om, enligt Jesper Jakobsson som är rättschef för länsstyrelsen i Skåne, rapporterar P4 Kristianstad. Anledningen är att valet kan överklagas till Valprövningsnämnden. De kan sedan ta beslut om omval till kommunfullmäktige i Simrishamn. Talmannen Andreas Norlén (M) fångades utanför riksdagen på onsdagen och fick frågor om hur det går med sonderingsuppdraget. Just nu har Magdalena Andersson (S) fått uppdraget att försöka bilda regering. – Hon har uppdraget att rapportera till den nya riksdagens talman och det blir i nästa vecka. Så att vi får se hur det går, säger han till Expressens Nina Svanberg. Just nu skakas Vänsterpartiet av en intern kris med misstankar om valfusk. Magdalena Anderssons möjligheter att bilda en regering utmanas också av Centerpartiet och Vänsterpartiets röda linjer. Hur är stämningen i riksdagen med allt som pågår? – Det är ju en stämning av uppbrott. Det är ett antal ledamöter som lämnar riksdagen och som håller på och packar. Det är lite uppropsstämning i bemärkelsen att det kommer nya ledamöter, och sen är det såklart en laddning kring det politiska läget som känns i riksdagshuset, precis som i samhället i övrigt, säger han. Tre personer är misstänkta i utredningen om valfusk i Borlänge, skriver SVT Nyheter. Riksenheten mot korruption inledde en förundersökning om otillbörligt verkande vid röstning den första september. En vecka senare lades utredningen ned, på beslut av åklagaren, enligt handlingar. – Initialt lades den ned på bevisproblem. Sedan framkom det vissa uppgifter som gjorde att det fanns skäl att titta på det här igen, säger Oskar Edvardsson till SVT.
